Equipment / R-2000

HEAVY WORK-CLASS / 1,000 M

R-2000

Deep-water work with a TMS-based system.

A 2.2 t heavy work-class ROV rated to 1,000 m, supplied with a tether management system and shore control for subsea engineering, survey and recovery tasks.

Read the application guide

Configuration checks

  • Confirm the support vessel, A-frame or crane, deck space and power for a 2.2 t vehicle plus TMS.
  • Define manipulators, tools and survey sensors; payload is quoted without TMS.
  • Agree crew size, training and commissioning for the complete system.

COMPLETE SYSTEM

Specify more than
the vehicle.

The system comprises the vehicle, umbilical management, a tether management system (TMS) and shore control. Heavy systems are quoted per project; the delivered scope and acceptance tests are confirmed item by item.

Confirm in the delivered scope

  • Vehicle, tether management system (TMS) and umbilical
  • Launch and recovery system or A-frame interface
  • Control container, shore power and software
  • Manipulators, tools and survey sensors
  • Spares, manuals, commissioning and crew training

Standard, optional and custom items must be listed separately in the quotation.

QUESTIONS

Before you specify the R-2000.

What has the R-2000 been used for?

The manufacturer reports an emergency recovery platform built around the R-2000 for the Nanshan research port in Sanya, China, covering recovery of test equipment within about 1,000 m water depth around the port. This is a manufacturer reference, not a project delivered by PanPan Marine.

How is a heavy ROV system quoted?

Each project defines the vehicle configuration, TMS, launch system, control container, tools and support. Lead time, commissioning and training are part of the quotation.
